_comment: Dead/error-page signatures — the ONE source for both the post-capture sweep (bin/lib/_add_dead_check_body.py) and kb-add duplicate detection (src/athena/plugin.js findDuplicate). Each pattern is a case-insensitive regex tested against a page's title and the head of its body. Keep them conservative: the sweep TRASHES any fresh raw that matches, so a false positive drops a real capture. Patterns must be valid in both Python `re` and JavaScript RegExp (no lookbehind, no named groups, no inline flags).
